description: This Java class defines a Spring repository for accessing and manipulating billing category data in a database. It contains methods for counting records, retrieving all categories with aggregate data, finding categories by ID, inserting new categories, and updating the hourly rate of existing categories. It uses JDBC template for database operations and defines row mappers for converting query results into DTO objects.

classes.name: BillingCategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class for billing categories, providing database access methods.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of billing categories in the database.

methods.name: findAllWithAggregates
methods.description: Retrieves all billing categories along with total hours and revenue per category.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a billing category by its ID, returning an Optional of BillingCategoryDto.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new billing category into the database with specified name, description, and hourly rate.

methods.name: updateRate
methods.description: Updates the hourly rate of a billing category identified by ID, returning an Optional of the updated DTO.
